_meta.purpose: Fail-closed allowlist for NEAR AI Cloud model-node measurements. Values that are not independently published are tagged source=observed and must be treated as first-observation pins, not third-party proof.
_meta.os_image_hash_source: Phala Cloud OS image registry for dstack-nvidia-0.5.12: https://cloud.phala.com/dstack/0.5.12 (also listed at https://cloud.phala.com/verification/os-images).
_meta.mr_td_rtmr_source: observed from live NEAR AI Cloud TDX quotes on 2026-11-05 (Africa/Lagos). dstack does not publish a single MRTD/RTMR0-2 for a version: those registers also encode VM CPU/RAM/device config, so independent precomputation needs the exact VmConfig. Limitation documented in README.
_meta.rt_mr3: NOT pinned: includes instance-id and runtime events. Verified by event-log replay only.
_meta.compose_pin: Pinned value is sha256(app_compose with the single 'INSTANCE_LABEL=gpuNN' replaced by 'INSTANCE_LABEL=<INSTANCE_LABEL>'). The verifier still checks the RAW sha256(app_compose) against MRCONFIGID and the RTMR3 compose-hash event; only the allowlist compare is normalized. DeepSeek and GLM nodes normalize to the same host compose (dstack-nvidia-0.5.11 name); Qwen's differs (0.5.12 name).
_meta.os_image_hash_check: os_image_hash is read from the replayed RTMR3 'os-image-hash' event (measured), cross-checked against tcb_info, then compared to this pin.
_meta.coverage: Label 'Hardware + host stack verified'. RTMR3 events are: system-preparing, app-id, compose-hash, instance-id, boot-mr-done, mr-kms, os-image-hash, key-provider, storage-fs, system-ready (+ nearai-replica-report-key-v1 on some nodes). The model-serving container (nearai/cvm-compose-files YAML) is NOT measured in RTMR3. compose-manager publishes a separately-quoted action log (compose_up file_sha256 values) but each node runs several compose files concurrently, so which container served a given model cannot be pinned; the model container is NOT covered.

rt_mr0.note: RTMR0 encodes VM shape. Primary value = 64 vCPU / 8 GPU VMs (all 3 models). also_observed = a 12 vCPU / 1 GPU Qwen replica seen 2026-11-05 ~11:40 WAT that serves the SAME signing_address 0x835a..aa26 (signing key is shared across replicas); MRTD and RTMR1/2 identical.

deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017.note: compose manifest name says 0.5.11 but os_image_hash matches published dstack-nvidia-0.5.12

z-ai/glm-5.3-flash.note: compose manifest name says 0.5.11 but os_image_hash matches published dstack-nvidia-0.5.12; previously RTMR3 replay failed on empty-digest top-level event_log — verifier now uses NEAR official digest-recompute for RTMR3
